NFL DFS Tight End Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 17, 10:53 PM ET

Brock Bowers is the top-projected tight end on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 18.6 DraftKings points for $7,500, against Buffalo. Trey McBride (18.1, $7,200) and Travis Kelce (14.1, $5,500) are next.

Isaiah Likely returns the most per dollar among tight ends projected for at least 7 points: 2.93 projected points per $1,000 at $4,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 17, 10:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Tight ends to know in Week 6

Brock Bowers, LV vs BUF ($7,500)

Brock Bowers carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 18.6 DraftKings points at $7,500. That is 0.4 points clear of Trey McBride. The model gives him 7.9 targets on 28.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.48 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Bowers averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 38.2, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 5.5-point underdog at home against Buffalo, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Trey McBride, ARI at LAR ($7,200)

Trey McBride projects 2nd at the position with 18.1 DraftKings points at $7,200. The model gives him 11.3 targets on 41.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.52 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McBride averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 35.7, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 12.5-point underdog on the road against the Rams, with an implied team total of 19.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Tyler Higbee, LAR vs ARI ($3,400)

Tyler Higbee projects for 9.8 DraftKings points at $3,400, which works out to 2.87 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 tight ends the model projects for 7 or more points. The model gives him 3.4 targets on 19.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Higbee averaged 9.8 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 25.0, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32 in a game totaled at 51.5.
